name: Pagination
purpose: Present polished movement through ordered result pages with current, boundary, and ellipsis states.
useWhen: A result set or collection is divided into multiple ordered pages.

avoidWhen.condition: The controls move between guide articles, ancestors, or local panels.

composition: Compose Root and List with Previous, Page, Ellipsis, and Next parts; use real destinations when each page has a URL.

rules.statement: Adapt visible page ranges at narrow widths without removing previous/next meaning or current-page state.
Load styles.css or core.css plus pagination.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Pagination for previous/next documentation guides or allowing controls to wrap into an unreadable grid.
commonMistakes.correction: Use ordinary guide navigation links and reserve Pagination for numbered collections.

validation: Check first, middle, last, current, disabled, ellipsis, long labels, narrow widths, focus, touch targets, and RTL.
Confirm URL pages are links and CSS is loaded.
